name: Open Your Heart to Me
description: At Ochkanatlan, you discover an underground structure so deep as to seem bottomless...

steps.description: Investigate the source of the sound
Deliver the heart fragments to Ixlel
Evade the Secret Source Sentinel attack
Deliver the heart fragments to Ixlel
Evade the Secret Source Sentinel attack
Help Ixlel find the heart fragments
Help Ixlel find the heart fragments
Help Ixlel find the heart fragments
Investigate the source of the sound

dialogs.content: #What could this groove be for...? C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's follow {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} over there and have a look. Maybe there's something good waiting for us there!
The sovereign ruler of the Land of Se{RUBY#[D]Chichen Uctokah}ven Flames extends salutations unto you, chosen one. May your path be one paved with flowers that shall never wither.
That voice... Sounds like it came from this... big statue.
Who are you?
Dragonlord Ix Uxul Tz'ib{RUBY#[D]Type-L Self-Regulating Overseer Array Integrated Processing Unit} Bolon Ch'ule-L is my name, aforetime the ruler of Chichen Uctokah.
Ixu... What's your name now? Sure that's something you call yourself, and not some kind of mumbo-jumbo spell?
Whatever, Paimon's gonna call you "Ixlel." That'll do. Not like she'll remember the rest anyway!
According to the sacred dest{RUBY#[D]K'uhul}ined path hath ye and those with ye... No, wait! What did you name me, you white, round, elemental floating object!?
#And who are you calling a "white, round, elemental floating object"!? Paimon's the name, this is {NICKNAME}, and...
Rraaar!
#And this is {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.
Also, you're the one who called yourself "Ix-whachamacallitagain-lel," or whatever, didn't you?
S—Such impertinence! This sacred name comes from the most glorious of rulers. How dare this white, round, elemental floating object speak thus, and vastly overstep its station!
#Noble {NICKNAME}! Forgive my blunt speech, but surely you grant your servant gross latitude, that it should address a sovereign ruler thusly!
Paimon is not my servant.
Hmph, that's right! We're the best of friends!
You... friends with an elemental floating object? A... unique choice, I must confess.
#In any case, do accept my apologies, noble {NICKNAME}. You have sojourned far to reach this place, and yet this all-too-humiliating form is all I can display before you.
Did this despicable statue not entrap me, I would surely have presented myself to you in a more elegant fashion, whether it be in a Dragonlord's form, or a mortal's guise...
Wait, so you're stuck in there?
Hmph. And you have reason to think otherwise? Think me a mere talking statue, do you?
But... this is the sorta place where "a mere talking statue" wouldn't be too out of place, don'cha think?
Gah. You insolent creature! I am the sovereign ruler of Chichen Uctokah, a great and glorious Dragonlord... You dare... You dare...!
If not for that most despised of betrayals, I would never have been trapped in this crude carving!
#B—But anyway! Noble {NICKNAME}, let me cut this long story short — I am in need of your aid.
In what matter?
My heart was once ripped apart through betrayal, before being hidden in various devices. I would ask you to seek those shards for me. Once that is done...
Cut my chest open as you would peel Grainfruit leaves, and dig my heart out.
Sure... Uh, wait a minute. You just said something super scary so casually...
Scary? You mean the Grainfruit? How chicken-hearted you are, elemental floating object...
What? What are you talking about? Who'd be afraid of Grainfruit anyway? Paimon's talking about that last part, with the whole "dig out your heart" thing!
#Hmm? Is that not a more pedestrian thing than Grainfruit? Ah, Noble {NICKNAME}, do you not have your servants attend you as you partake in sacrifices?
Why do you want your heart to be dug out?
For you are the noble one, the Chosen of Dragons. Apart from our lost colleagues in ruler{RUBY#[D]Ajaw}ship, you alone have the right to give unto me release befitting of my rank.

#If you are familiar with the ancient ways, O Noble {NICKNAME}, surely you must know that my hea{RUBY#[D]Clustered Storage Array}rt, created as it was in great antiquity, holds all the memories that were once mine.
The traitor — may his name be cast into the everlasting flames to burn for thirteen thousand years! — stole my authority, using memories to entrap me here.
What? Can memories be used to restrain peopl— Err, Dragons?
Hmph. So ignorant are you that it is quite adorable, elemental floating object. Had my authority not been lost, I might yet have taken you in as a pet.
For mayfly-races, memories are naturally as sweet and lovely as Quenepa Berries, but for long-lived species, memories are naught but curses and shackles.
That's... not easy to understand...
Whatever the case may be, it was this means by which that wretched renegade forced me to sing for his empire, and for his delusions — for he did not know how to operate this city.
His pitiful empire and his laughable delusions were both reduced to ash. Yet, here I remain still, imprisoned in this miserable effigy.
Um, even if you say so, it still feels strange to find your heart, only to dig it out again...
Heh... Still you do not comprehend, you white, round, elemental floating object?
My life's thread is all but spun out. And even were that not so, my consciousness shall also be utterly depleted in thirty winters.
#My dignity permits me not to die enslaved or confined! Therefore, noble {NICKNAME}, I beg of you, grant me release.
I cannot destroy myself, but should you retrieve those fragments, I can pour what remains of my li{RUBY#[D]Energy}fe into them, restoring my broken heart to its original state.
This is a step of <color=#00E1FFFF>self-protection</color>, and only by this may I not violate the dest{RUBY#[D]K'uhul}ined, sacred law.
After that, dig my heart out. It is this heart that binds me, that enslaves me, that has tormented me endlessly all these millennia.
It is the true heart of a Dragonlord, before which all of humanity's gems must shy away in shame. And it shall be your reward — what say you?
I understand.
You have my thanks. Then, let me sing here, and wait for good tidings from you. Little else can I do now, I fear.
Please... find my heart, and grant me noble relief.
Is there no other way?
Hehe... It seems you have yet to meet my colleagues of old.
Otherwise, they would have told you that destruction is our dest{RUBY#[D]K'uhul}ined path. There is no need for another, nor is it possible to find one.
Regardless, I will sing here and await your decision.
For what reward?
Haha. Fret not. Once I am done speaking, you shall know your reward's value.
Well said. Now then, Mini Pie, I must have words with thee...
Hey, hey! Who's "Mini Pie," huh? Don't get ahead of yourself over some flattery, you hear?
"Chosen one"? You mean me?
Indeed. Chosen of Dragons you are, and noble elect of mine also.
Hey, Ixlel! We've found the bits and bobs you need!
Wh—Who do you name "Ixlel," you insolent whelp? I've told you, my name is...
#Alright, never mind! I tire of waiting to die! Come, noble {NICKNAME}, put ye these into my chest...
And then dig out my heart, and allow me to perish by your noble hands!
Rejoice thou also, O white, round, elemental floating object! For I shall bestow upon you too the honor of witnessing the passing of Chichen Uctokah's ruler!
Whoa, don't get so excited about this stuff, would ya? Anyway, we just need to put these components in first, right?
Indeed, indeed! Come now, I shall open my heart to you. Take it out, and this task shall be done!
Ugh, do you really have to put it that way?
(Insert the components.)
Uh, and then...
Um, Ixlel? You there?

Whoa! Abyssal monsters! Why'd they just pop out all of a sudden!?
